summary: Aura Biosciences filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 39,591,000 common shares at $6.00/share and pre-funded warrants at $5.99999/warrant, raising $244.7M net proceeds. Part of proceeds (~$39M) will repurchase 6,922,870 shares from Matrix Capital Management. The offering is a standard equity shelf takedown with pre-funded warrants, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, or restructuring elements. The filing is a routine capital raise by an issuer, with no corporate event triggering special-situations categorization.
